keep_inline_images_in naming 'a' keeps an image inside a link that also holds a block element

```elixir title="Elixir"
options_value = %HtmlToMarkdown.ConversionOptions{keep_inline_images_in: ["a"]}
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<a href=\"https://example.com/file.pdf\"><img src=\"pdf.png\"><p>Download PDF</p></a>", options_value)
IO.inspect(result.content)
```
